struct.title: Cyclic peptide binder of the WBM-site of WDR5

pubmed.rcsb_pubmed_abstract_text: WDR5 is an adaptor protein involved in the regulation of various epigenetic modifier complexes. Various inhibitors have been described but only as inhibitors of its protein-protein interactions. Here we describe peptidic macrocycles that act as inhibitors of the interaction between WDR5 and long non-coding RNAs. The findings provide a new strategy to modulate the biological function of WDR5 as an RNA binding epigenetic regulator.
rcsb_pubmed_affiliation_info: Chemical Genomics Centre of the Max Planck, Society Max Planck Institute of Molecular Physiology, Otto-Hahn-Strasse 11, 44227 Dortmund, Germany. peter.t-hart@mpi-dortmund.mpg.de.
